anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading system shows zero total profit/loss and ROI, with no active trades, which might indicate inactivity or issues with trade execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review AI system configuration and logs to ensure it is correctly set up to generate insights and make adjustments.
Evaluate trading strategies and market conditions to ensure they are aligned and capable of executing trades.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve any bottlenecks or inefficiencies.
recommendations.rationale: Prolonged high CPU usage can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to ensure it is operational and capable of generating insights.
